plugins.name: product-metrics
plugins.description: Product Metrics skills for any online store: set up and check server-side conversion tracking, bid on profit (POAS), new customers, returning customers or lifetime value in Google Ads, Meta and ChatGPT Ads, and analyse Google Ads with real figures.
